conclusion:
NO ROW MAY BE ADDED, BUT TWO ROWS' BASIS TEXT AND ONE RESIDUAL RISK CHANGE.

1. NO CUTOVER. No SGX-authored, publicly reachable artifact states the day of the 2016 equity-index hours revision. Under LAW-NO-FABRICATED-DATES the 2017-07-10 knowledge boundary on the Japan (SGX_EQUITY_INDEX_JAPAN), China (A50) and Singapore (SiMSCI/STI) keys STANDS unchanged, and no revision row is added at 2016-07-11 or 2016-11-14. Served windows are untouched on every key.

2. THE BRACKET NARROWS, ON SGX-AUTHORED EVIDENCE. history.rs's paragraph "A CAPTURE DATES THE OBSERVATION, NEVER THE STATE" currently brackets state A's onset only by the change log ("its entries of 2016-04-22 … and 2016-07-15 … place the move in 2016, though neither states a day (#66)"). Add: SGX's own Derivatives Trading Calendar 2016 — still served verbatim from KGI Futures (Singapore), an SGX-DT member, at kgieworld.sg/docs/SGXDerivativesTradingCalendar2016_AUG.pdf, PDF created 31 August 2016 — prints the S0 grid unchanged (Nikkei "7.45am to 2.25pm / 3.15pm to 2.00am", A50 "9.00am to 3.55pm / 4.40pm to 2.00am", SiMSCI and STI "8.30am to 5.10pm / 6.15pm to 2.00am", MSCI Taiwan "8.45am to 1.45pm / 2.35pm to 2.00am") and states "All dates and information are accurate as of 24 December 2015." So the S0→A window closes from (2013-08-20, 2017-07-05) to (2015-12-24, 2017-07-05), with the change log's two 2016 entries and SGX's Titan newsletter of 27 July 2016 all inside it.

3. RESIDUAL RISK (2) IS PARTLY RETIRED. history.rs currently says "the 2014-2016 calendar editions lived in a WCM store that is in neither the archive nor the live site, so states between S0 and A are unwitnessed". That is now half wrong: the 2016 edition survives on a member mirror and witnesses S0 as of 24 December 2015. Rewrite it to name the 2014, 2015 and 2016-Oct-end editions as the ones still unrecovered, and to record that the 2016 edition SGX regenerated on 2016-08-31 must be read at its own as-of date and never at its creation date — a second worked instance of the module's own "a served document can be stale, never early" rule, and a sharper one than the wcm/connect orphan because here SGX printed the stale date itself.

4. NEW CHANNEL FOR docs/schedules/sources.md. kgieworld.sg (KGI Futures / KGI Securities Singapore, an SGX-DT Trading and Clearing Member) is a third verbatim SGX-circular member mirror alongside CITIC Futures International (DT/AM 15 of 2025) and Fubon Futures (DT/AM 50 of 2024): SGX-letterheaded circulars at /futures/resources/ck/files/docs/ (verified on DT/AM 103 of 2020, 9 November 2020) and verbatim SGX calendars at /docs/. The channel-limit note in sources.md should name it.

5. NEW RESIDUAL RISK TO STATE BESIDE THE JAPAN, CHINA AND SINGAPORE FLOOR ROWS. Third-party member material, inadmissible for a row under LAW-PRIMARY-SOURCES, now dates two events inside the undated window: Phillip Futures (1 July 2016) states the Nikkei suite's T open moved 07:45 → 07:30 with effect from 11 July 2016, and both KGI and Phillip (11 and 16 November 2016) state that the market-wide hours revision took effect at the Titan DT/DC launch on Monday 14 November 2016 — the day SGX's own Futures Trading Rules carry thirty "Amended on 14 November 2016" annotations for the QUEST→Titan system cutover. If the second were ever SGX-sourced, all three keys' 2017-07-10 knowledge boundaries would become a cutover keyed to Monday 2016-11-14 (already a Monday, which is what the wrapping-close rule requires), and the crate would stop under-reporting roughly eight months of a 2h45m-longer T+1 leg. Record this as risk, not as a date.

6. FOLLOW-UPS TO OPEN (LAW-FOLLOW-UPS-ARE-ISSUES). Two named SGX documents would close #66 and neither is reachable today: (a) SGX Circular DT/AM 80 of 2016, Appendix 1 ("DTAM 80 of 2016 Trading Calendar_Appendix 1_v07_AK"), which KGI itself describes as "the list of contracts and their revised trading hours" — SGX's own copy and KGI's mirror are both dead and unarchived; (b) the Titan DTDC newsletter of 27 July 2016, which SGX still serves but RC4-128 encrypts. A third, DT/AM 76 of 2016 dated 24 October 2016, governs holiday-session scope and belongs to LAW-HOLIDAY-SCOPE, not to this row. Any future recovery of (a) is the single highest-value target for the SGX pre-2020 work.
